descriptions.en: The dogmatic Arbiters seek a truth through discipline and practice. They reject the Tenno as Warrior mythology... A lie constructed to limit their potential.
descriptions.zh: 教条式的仲裁者通过纪律与实际作为来寻求真理。他们否认天诺战士即是战士的神话…这是个被编造出来用以限制他们无尽潜力的谎言。

descriptions.en: A vast consciousness watching with a curious eye. Seemingly devoid of emotion, Suda's thirst for knowledge and abhorrence of destruction can only be described as passionate.
descriptions.zh: 有着丰富的知觉并以求知的角度关注世务。表面上看来虽毫无情感，但苏达对知识的渴望以及对破坏的厌恶，只能以慷慨激昂来形容。

descriptions.en: A warrior only grows if they face the ultimate enemy. Themselves.
descriptions.zh: 一名战士只有在面对终极敌人 -「自我」时，才能有所成长。

descriptions.en: Heirs to the legacy of Albrecht Entrati, his powerful Orokin family encountered disaster, isolation and bitter division on Deimos. The arrival of the Tenno, beneficiaries of their Void research, may bring fresh hope - and a deeper understanding of the world that has trapped their family.
descriptions.zh: 他们是阿尔布雷希特·英择谛的继承人，这个强大的奥罗金家族在火卫二上遭遇了沉重的灾难、孤离和痛苦的分裂。而虚空研究的受益者，天诺战士的到来，或许会给这些可怜的人们带来新的希望；以及进一步探索这个困住了他们的诡秘世界。

descriptions.en: While the Entrati family's cohort of lethal Necramechs succumbed to the corrupting influence of Deimos, Loid's shielding kept him sane, as well as preserving what was left of his ‘passenger', the Cephalon Otak. Together they maintain a proud tradition of loyal service.
descriptions.zh: 当英择谛家族引以为傲的致命殁世机甲都屈服于火卫二上的腐朽势力时，洛德的护盾使他得以保存理智；也一并保住了他当时的"乘客"所幸存的一切——中枢奥塔。他们一起协力维持住了忠诚服务这个傲人的传统。

descriptions.en: Animals sent into the Void by Albrecht Entrati, the three surviving Cavia came back changed forever. They gained human intelligence, but could speak only incoherent Voidtongue until the Jahu Gargoyle made them intelligible. Despite what Albrecht did to them, they have resolved to assist his chosen Operator.
descriptions.zh: 这三只仅存的科维兽是被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛送入虚空的动物，它们在回来时已经被彻底改变了。它们获得了人类的智力，但只能讲出无法理解的虚空语，直到形态合成兽像将它们的话变得可理解。尽管阿尔布雷希特曾经这么对待它们，但它们还是决定协助他所选择的指挥官。

descriptions.en: Support and rewards for Tenno fighting in active operations.
descriptions.zh: 向在当前行动中奋战的天诺战士提供补给和奖励。

descriptions.en: Formerly human operatives, the six members of the Hex were transformed into Protoframes by Albrecht Entrati. Filled with uncanny power and mourning their lost humanity, they continue their mission of mercy in beleaguered Höllvania.
descriptions.zh: 六名六人组成员原本是人类特工，后来被阿尔布雷希特·英择谛改造成原型战甲。他们获得了不可思议的力量，但却哀悼着自己失去的人性，继续在被围攻的霍瓦尼亚执行他们的救赎使命。

descriptions.en: Break veils. Free Brothers. Stop Narmer.
descriptions.zh: 破除面障。解放兄弟。阻止合一众。

descriptions.en: Through Synthesis we can rebuild and preserve. Create memory-immortals within this data oasis. Will you become enlightened, Tenno? Will you hunt for me?
descriptions.zh: 借由结合仪式，我们得以将这些知识复原并传承下去。在这数据绿洲中创建永世留芳的记忆。天诺战士，你们愿受到启发吗？愿为我狩猎吗？

descriptions.en: Only through the restoration of a pure humanity and the repopulation of Earth can the conflict end. The New Loka are worshipers of the human form and Earth, before its corruption.
descriptions.zh: 认为唯有通过恢复人性的纯真和地球的复育才能终止冲突。在崩解之前，新世间是人类与地球的崇拜者。

descriptions.en: Find Mushroom samples in the Deepmines
descriptions.zh: 在深矿中寻找蘑菇样本

descriptions.en: A tight knit band of merchants, hucksters, and survivors, the Ostrons call Cetus their home. The town was built around an Orokin Tower, that both protects and nourishes them.
descriptions.zh: 由一群贸易商、小贩与幸存者紧密结合在一起组成，奥斯唐人称希图斯为家园。这座城镇建立在奥罗金塔周边，高塔不但庇护了他们，还滋养了他们。

descriptions.en: A secretive order, loyal to the mysterious and reclusive 'Unum.' Some say their relationship to cause and effect is unnatural, their knowledge profane. When a Quill acts, things change.
descriptions.zh: 一个神秘的团体，向神秘隐居的乌努母神效忠。有人说他们与因果有着不自然的联系，而他们的知识是亵渎的。当一名夜羽行动时，情势就将改变。

descriptions.en: A collective of brilliant and powerful merchants, splintered from the Corpus. Their goal is to restore order by bringing prosperity and direction to the violent world they study.
descriptions.zh: 一个从科普斯中分裂出来，十分卓越与强大的商人集体。经过研究与观察，他们的目标是借由将繁荣与趋势导入这个暴力的世界来恢复一切的秩序。

descriptions.en: The Veil see corruption all around them. They are honor-bound to heal the system through a great and violent purge. No cost too great, no blood too precious.
descriptions.zh: 血色面纱见证了他们周围一切的腐败。他们以荣誉为号召，通过强大的暴力净化来治愈星系。不惜一切代价，不惜流尽鲜血。

descriptions.en: Indentured workers to the Corpus; the indispensable backbone of the Corpus business model on Venus. Manning factories, rail tractors and mines they work to pay off the artificial bodies (rigs) they bought in order to work.
descriptions.zh: 科普斯的契约工人；是金星的科普斯商业模式中必不可缺的骨干。运行工厂、操作轨道牵引机并挖掘矿山，他们通过工作来偿还人造身体（机械装备），而他们购买这些正是为了工作。

descriptions.en: Hangin' with their logical fam in the ducts of Fortuna, the Ventkids get by stealing parts from the Corpus and running K-Drive races out on the Vallis. At night the ventways bang to the sound of skeg - to the chagrin of the locals.
descriptions.zh: 和他们的义亲们住在福尔图娜的管道中。通风小子以偷取科普斯商会的零件为生，并在山谷中进行 K 式悬浮板的比赛。到了晚上，通风管道会响起 skeg，让当地人大为懊恼。

descriptions.en: Solaris United's core personnel operating under the name of that group's enigmatic and anonymous figurehead. SU is the public face of the struggle. Vox Solaris is something else entirely; something known only to Eudico... and the Quills.
descriptions.zh: 索拉里斯联盟的核心成员借以行事的匿名神秘领袖形象。索联是奋斗反抗的代表。而索拉里斯之声则完全是另一种存在，只有尤迪科……和夜羽才知道这其中的秘密。

descriptions.en: Led by a battle-hardened Grineer deserter, the Steel Meridian fight a guerrilla war against a vast enemy. They are sworn protectors of what little remains of the colonies.
descriptions.zh: 由一位久经沙场的克隆尼叛逃者所带领，钢铁防线以游击战来对抗一个巨大的敌人。他们宣誓要保护那一小块残存的殖民地。

descriptions.en: Granted a second existence through the mysterious power of the Void, the four Holdfasts struggle to keep their sanity and their vessel intact. The return of the Tenno may turn the tide.
descriptions.zh: 通过虚空的力量得以再度生存，这四名坚守者奋力保持理智和他们的船只完好无损。天诺战士的重返或许能扭转局势。
